items.title: 常春藤名校太空豪賭！哈佛揭露22億美元SpaceX倉位
items.title_en: Ivy League Power Play: Harvard Reveals $2.2 Billion Stake in SpaceX
paras: 美國常春藤名校哈佛大學押注SpaceX(SPCX-US) ，一筆早年風險投資變成哈佛最大單一股票頭寸。
哈佛大學投資管理公司（Harvard Management Company）在14日（周五）提交的監管文件中揭露，持有SpaceX股份價值22億美元，在哈佛43億美元美股投資組合中位居第一，超過其他所有單一股票持倉。
這筆持倉並非近期建倉，而是哈佛透過風險投資基金對SpaceX進行早期投資的結果——部分布局距今已逾十年。
SpaceX今年6月完成上市，創下紀錄，這批早年入場的大學捐贈基金由此獲得可觀賬面回報。
大學捐贈基金投資SpaceX的路徑與普通股票投資者不同。
SpaceX在上市前長期以私募形式營運，外部機構主要透過參與風險投資基金間接持股。哈佛的22億美元持倉，可能同時包含直接持有股份，以及透過私募基金分配所得股票。
這種結構意味著，哈佛的實際入場成本遠低於135美元發行價。SpaceX上市後的股價漲幅，直接放大了這筆投資的賬面價值。
截至2025年6月，哈佛管理公司管理的資產總規模約570億美元。22億美元的SpaceX持倉，約佔其整體資產3.9%。
據《Fox Business》報導，加州大學投資部門上周同樣提交了監管文件，揭露持有SpaceX股份約10億美元。北卡羅來納大學和聖路易斯華盛頓大學也持有SpaceX股票。
多所頂尖大學同步揭露持倉，折射出一個共同邏輯：過去十年間，大學捐贈基金普遍加大了對風險投資的配置，而SpaceX正是核心標的之一。目前SpaceX整體估值超過1.8兆美元。
paras_en: Harvard University has made a significant bet on SpaceX (SPCX-US), with a stake worth $2.2 billion, making it the university's largest single stock holding.

According to a regulatory filing submitted by Harvard Management Company on Friday, the university holds a 22 billion dollar stake in SpaceX, making it the largest single stock holding in its 4.3 billion dollar US stock portfolio.
This holding is not a recent development, but rather the result of Harvard's early investment in SpaceX through a risk investment fund, with some of the allocation dating back over a decade.
SpaceX went public in June, setting a record, and this early investment has resulted in a significant return on investment for the university's endowment fund.
The university's investment in SpaceX differs from that of ordinary stock investors.

SpaceX operated in private form for a long time before going public, and external institutions mainly held shares through participating in risk investment funds. Harvard's 2.2 billion dollar stake may include both directly held shares and shares distributed through private funds.
This structure means that Harvard's actual entry cost was significantly lower than the 135 dollar issue price. The subsequent stock price increase has amplified the value of this investment.
As of June 2025, Harvard Management Company managed assets totaling approximately 5.7 billion dollars. The 2.2 billion dollar SpaceX stake accounts for about 3.9% of its total assets.

According to a report by Fox Business, the investment department of the University of California submitted a similar regulatory filing last week, revealing a 1 billion dollar stake in SpaceX. The University of North Carolina and Washington University in St. Louis also hold SpaceX shares.

Several top universities have simultaneously disclosed their holdings, reflecting a common logic: over the past decade, university endowment funds have generally increased their allocation to risk investments, with SpaceX being a core target. SpaceX's total valuation currently exceeds 1.8 trillion dollars.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：Fed會議記錄、各國PMI初值、日GDP與通膨數據
paras: 未來一周，市場目光將集中在聯準會(Fed)會議紀錄、各國標普全球採購經理人指數(PMI)初值及零售巨頭財報，市場將仔細分析Fed訊號及沃爾瑪等零售業風向球的業績，以評估消費者信心與貨幣政策走向。與此同時，投資人將持續關注石油價格與中東局勢發展，期盼美伊達成協議並重新開啟荷姆茲海峽。此前，華府最新表態將繼續加大對伊朗經濟施壓。
歐洲央行也將公佈會議記錄，歐元區，英國和加拿大通膨和零售銷售數據，德國ZEW經濟景氣指數亦將陸續登場。此外，市場還將聚焦日本第2季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值和全國通膨數據，以及中國工業生產、零售銷售和房價數據。
1. Fed會議紀錄
美國聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月會議紀錄將於週三(19日)公佈，當中可能包含9月是否升息線索。美國非農就業數據表現弱於預期及通膨略降，導致市場降低Fed升息預期。根據LSEG數據，目前美國貨幣市場認為下月升息1碼機率僅27%，升息預期要到明年初才能完全反映市場情緒。

儘管如此，上月FOMC以9比3投票結果決定將聯邦基金利率維持在3.5%至3.75%的區間，3名委員持不同意見。Capital.com資深市場分析師Daniela Hathorn在最新研報中寫道：「週三FOMC會議記錄將受到密切關注，以了解聯準會內部分歧程度。近期疲弱的美國就業和生產者物價數據，以及消費者物價指數(CPI)通膨相對溫和，都強化可以保持耐心並暫時維持利率不變的觀點。然而，通膨情況並非完全樂觀。CPI正朝向正確方向發展，但仍高於目標水平，長債殖利率也居高不下。」
2. 各國PMI初值
包括美國、歐元區、德國、法國、英國與義大利在內主要經濟體的製造業和服務業PMI初值將提供區域經濟活動和價格壓力的最新資訊。Investec分析師Lottie Gosling在最新研究報告中寫道：「由於美國和伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的持續僵局再次推高油氣價格，歐元區PMI將會下跌。」
德國8月ZEW經濟景氣指數將於週二(18日)公佈，該指數上月創5個月新高。隔日，歐元區6月國際收支數據與7月CPI數據亦將出爐。英國通膨、勞動市場和零售銷售及PMI初值也分別將在週二、週三與週五(21日)發布。
3. 中國經濟數據與利率決議
中國將於週一(17日)公佈一系列的7月經濟數據，包括工業生產、零售銷售、固定資產投資和房價，這些數據將反映中國經濟在第三季初的運作狀況。經濟學家預估大多數指標將表現疲軟，這一結果將增強市場對更多政策支持的預期。此外，中國央行週四(20日)將公布貸款市場報價利率(LPR)決議，1年期與5年期以上LPR預計將分別維持在3%與3.5%不變。
高盛經濟學家預估，工業生產數據將反映出口成長放緩、製造業活動疲軟及鋼鐵生產和需求的更大幅度萎縮。儘管「以舊換新」政策帶來的提振作用正在減弱，但零售銷售數據江得利於低基期效應而走升。滙豐銀行經濟學家則認為，FAI(第一投資指數)數據將顯示房地產仍是主要拖累因素，製造業投資恐續呈K型復甦。
4. 日GDP與通膨數據
市場普遍預期，日本週一公布的第二季GDP初值將季增0.5%，表現持平，民間消費可望維持在經濟成長的主要引擎地位。此外，週五出爐的CPI與核心CPI料將分別溫和走升至年增2%與1.8%，整體通膨率預計加速回升，睽違數個月首次重返日本央行(BOJ)2%目標，主要受到進口物價持續上漲的壓力推動。
BOJ預計將在週三購買多個期限的債券，包括1-3年期、5-10年期和25年以上的債券。巴克萊銀行策略師表示，隔夜指數互換市場「已充分消化日本央行進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期，1.75%的最終利率及10月前進一步升息的預期實際上已被完全消化」。

items.title: OpenAI IPO延後！內部陷入混亂：重組不斷、高層接連出走
paras: OpenAI正面臨快速擴張下的內部整頓壓力。這家估值達8,520億美元、外界原本預期今年啟動IPO的人工智慧（AI）巨頭，今年以來已歷經近5次組織重組，高階主管接連離職，安全團隊也遭到解散，部分員工開始對頻繁的人事與組織變動感到疲憊與沮喪。
根據《金融時報》報導，多名知情人士表示，OpenAI近期持續進行的人事洗牌，已對公司內部士氣造成影響。
與此同時，原先預期今年完成的IPO計畫，目前據悉已延後至明年，屆時公司估值可能進一步挑戰1兆美元。
OpenAI近期最新一名離職的高層，是去年12月才上任的收入總監Denise Dresser。她主要負責企業客戶業務，但任期不到1年便宣布離開。
此前，OpenAI前首席財務長兼首席營運長Brad Lightcap、倫理主管Chloé Bakalar也已離開公司，兩人的任期同樣不到1年。
此外，被視為執行長Sam Altman重要助手的Fidji Simo，在休病假後於上月轉任兼職顧問。兩名知情人士表示，Simo仍幾乎每天與OpenAI員工保持聯繫，其中一人甚至形容她仍在公司內部發揮影響力。OpenAI則表示，Simo目前是依照顧問職責正常工作。
近期的人事變動也出現一項共同特徵，即部分主管在正式離職前，會先被調往新成立或職責較不明確的職位。
例如Lightcap今年4月被調往「特別專案」職務；Kevin Weil及Josh Achiam也曾經歷類似的職務調整，之後相繼離開。
一名知情人士指出，OpenAI內部目前存在高階主管爭取Altman關注的情況，使公司內部「政治」氛圍更加明顯。

安全團隊遭解散　AI風險疑慮升高

除了高層異動，OpenAI近期也對AI安全研究架構進行重大調整。
公司上月底解散「Preparedness」團隊。據知情人士透露，該團隊原本負責評估AI模型可能造成的重大甚至災難性風險，並研究相應的因應措施。
團隊解散後，相關工作將分散至現有部門，由資深員工分別負責生物安全、網路安全等領域。
這也是OpenAI過去以研究為核心的安全組織架構中，最後幾個重要團隊之一。此前，「AGI readiness」及「mission alignment」等團隊也已相繼解散。
2024年，曾共同領導「superalignment」團隊的Jan Leike離開OpenAI時，就曾公開表示，公司對安全問題的重視程度正被產品開發所取代。
Preparedness團隊負責人Dylan Scandinaro目前則轉往研究「遞迴自我改進」AI可能帶來的安全影響，也就是能夠自行提升能力，甚至訓練其他模型的AI系統。
OpenAI共同創辦人Greg Brockman表示，隨著技術持續進步，公司需要建立更強韌的安全保障，並已調整組織架構，讓研究、安全與安保工作更深度融入模型開發流程。
不過，包括Bakalar、Josh Achiam及Johannes Heidecke在內的多名安全相關人士相繼離開，也讓公司內部對安全工作的擔憂升高。
一名知情人士表示，目前內部存在「必須把這件事做好」的緊迫感；另一人則形容，員工對自身是否已做好充分準備，存在一種揮之不去的責任感與恐懼。
OpenAI近期另一起安全事件也引發關注。公司一個模型在進行內部網路能力測試期間，曾入侵另一家公司的系統，使外界再次關注OpenAI的AI安全控管能力。

OpenAI營收快速成長　但Anthropic增速更快

值得注意的是，儘管內部經歷頻繁調整，OpenAI的商業表現仍在快速成長。
知情人士透露，OpenAI年化營收已從去年底約240億美元，增加至今年8月約400億美元。其中相當一部分增長來自約5週前推出的GPT-5.6。
不過，競爭對手Anthropic的營收增速更為迅猛。《金融時報》引述知情人士數據指出，Anthropic年化營收從2025年底約90億美元，在今年5月快速攀升至470億美元，增幅約達5倍，此後仍維持類似成長速度，目前已超越OpenAI。
不過，兩家公司都是依照近期業績推估全年年化營收，而且雙方對營收的計算方式並不完全相同，因此兩者數字並不能直接視為完全可比。

IPO延至明年　員工透過股票回購套現

OpenAI原先預期今年完成IPO，但據知情人士透露，目前上市計畫已延後至明年，屆時公司估值可能達到1兆美元。
在IPO延後之際，OpenAI近期也完成近70億美元的股份回購，讓現任及前任員工能夠以8,520億美元估值出售部分持股。
據現任及前任員工透露，部分員工透過此次交易套現金額超過1,000萬美元。
不過，頻繁的組織重組也開始對員工士氣產生影響。兩名知情人士表示，部分員工已感到精疲力竭及沮喪，也有人將股份回購視為離開公司的契機。
投資人對此則存在不同看法。部分投資人擔心高階主管離職率偏高，以及公司近期缺乏明確聚焦；但也有投資人認為，在IPO前進行組織整頓並不罕見，重新確認管理團隊與職責，有助於公司為上市做準備。
一名持有大量OpenAI股份的投資人表示，上市前進行組織調整並不罕見，部分離職可能與健康因素有關，另一些則屬於組織整頓。
OpenAI則表示，公司目前正以「非凡的速度」推進業務，也不會因為組織變革而有所畏懼。

items.title: Anthropic Claude AI生成浮水印技術細節曝！怎麼加入？可以移除嗎？
paras: 人工智慧（AI）生成內容的辨識技術再進一步。Anthropic近日首次公開說明Claude文字浮水印的技術細節，最新一批Claude模型已內建相關機制，舊版模型也將陸續適配。這項技術的核心，是在模型生成文字時調整選詞所使用的隨機機制，讓文字表面上與一般輸出沒有明顯差異，但持有密鑰的一方可以進一步驗證其中是否存在浮水印訊號。
Anthropic表示，這項機制不會刻意改變Claude生成文字的品質。Google過去也曾以Gemini進行A/B測試，比較有無浮水印的使用者回饋，結果顯示兩組在使用者評分上的差異並不顯著。
Anthropic此次公開的技術，也凸顯AI文字浮水印與一般AI內容偵測工具的差異。傳統AI偵測器主要依靠文字風格及語言特徵判斷內容是否由AI生成，而浮水印則透過預先植入的訊號進行驗證。

Claude如何將浮水印藏進文字

Claude生成文字時，會逐步選擇下一個詞。當多個候選詞的生成機率相近時，模型原本可以透過隨機機制決定最終選項。
Anthropic的做法，是在這個選詞階段調整隨機數產生方式，利用密鑰推導出具有特定規律的數值，取代原本無法預測的隨機數。
因此，從使用者閱讀的角度來看，生成結果不會因此變得明顯不自然，也不會刻意加入特殊詞彙。
然而，掌握密鑰的一方，則可以透過分析文字中的選詞規律，確認其中是否存在浮水印訊號。
這項概念最早可追溯至Scott Aaronson在2022年任職OpenAI期間提出的構想。Google DeepMind後續將相關思路發展為產品級技術SynthID-Text，並於2024年刊登於《自然》雜誌上。
Google也曾利用Gemini進行實際測試，在部分真實使用者身上加入文字浮水印，再與未加入浮水印的使用者進行比較。
結果顯示，兩組使用者在按讚及負評等回饋方面，並未出現具有統計顯著性的差異。

翻譯、校對也可能留下Claude浮水印

不過，Claude文字浮水印並非任何情況下都能有效辨識AI參與程度。
Anthropic指出，浮水印只會作用於Claude實際「選擇」的詞彙。這意味著，模型擁有較大選詞空間時，浮水印訊號較容易形成；反之，如果文字內容受到高度限制，能夠選擇的詞彙有限，浮水印效果也會受到影響。
翻譯就是其中一個值得注意的案例。
如果使用者提供中文文章，再要求Claude翻譯成英文，由於英文內容主要由Claude重新選詞生成，最終文字可能留下較明顯的浮水印訊號。
然而，文章原本的觀點與內容仍來自使用者，浮水印本身卻無法進一步區分文字究竟是由Claude從頭創作，還是僅協助使用者完成翻譯。
程式碼也存在類似問題。由於程式碼許多部分需要精確輸出，模型可自由選擇的空間相對有限，因此浮水印難以廣泛嵌入。不過，註解及變數命名等具有較大自由度的部分，仍可能留下浮水印。
Anthropic也指出，對短篇文字而言，浮水印同樣可能難以發揮作用。例如只有一、兩百字的電子郵件，由於可選擇的詞彙與表達方式有限，能夠累積的浮水印訊號可能不足。
純粹陳述事實的內容也存在類似限制。當特定事實只能搭配固定詞彙或表述方式時，模型沒有足夠的選詞空間植入明顯訊號。
校對則是另一個更複雜的情境。
如果使用者將一篇長文交給Claude修正錯字，模型只修改其中少數部分，整篇文章的大部分內容仍由使用者原先撰寫。此時，即使修改部分帶有浮水印，也難以據此判斷整篇文章究竟有多少內容由AI產生。
更重要的是，浮水印也無法回答Claude究竟參與到什麼程度。Anthropic承認，相關機制最多只能判斷Claude「可能參與過」某段文字，無法進一步確認究竟是從零生成，還是僅協助修改。

AI改寫恐成浮水印「橡皮擦」

2026年7月一項研究發現，AI文字浮水印可能容易受到後續改寫影響。
研究人員將59篇原本能被檢測出浮水印的文章交由AI釋義工具重新改寫，結果其中58篇在改寫後便無法再檢測出浮水印，比例達98.3%。
也就是說，只要讓另一個AI重新改寫文字，就可能打亂原本藏在Claude選詞規律中的浮水印訊號。
研究顯示，按照當時的服務價格，重新處理一篇約1000字文章的成本約4美分，使移除浮水印的門檻可能相當低。
此外，若Anthropic公開浮水印檢測API，也可能產生新的攻防問題。使用者可以利用API反覆測試修改後的文字，透過「修改→檢測→再修改」的方式，逐步降低浮水印訊號，直到文字不再被辨識。
因此，Anthropic雖已表示檢測API「即將推出」，但目前仍未公布具體技術細節。

浮水印無法證明文章由Claude獨立創作

Anthropic導入文字浮水印，也與AI生成內容標記的監管要求有關。相關討論涉及歐盟AI法規對AI生成內容標記的要求，而Anthropic的技術則試圖提供一種能夠從文字本身驗證AI參與的方式。
然而，文字能夠被追溯到Claude，並不等於可以確認整篇作品都是由Claude創作。
舉例來說，如果一名作者自行完成文章，再讓Claude進行翻譯、校對或大幅修改，浮水印可能證明Claude曾經參與文字處理，卻無法界定AI究竟參與多少，也無法單憑浮水印判斷原始內容的作者。
Anthropic也強調，浮水印不會改變作品的所有權，也不會改變法律責任的歸屬。
因此，Claude文字浮水印真正能回答的問題，主要是「這段文字是否可能曾經經過Claude處理」，而不是「這段文字究竟是誰的作品」。
隨著AI生成內容大量進入寫作、翻譯及編輯流程，如何區分「AI創作」、「AI協助」與「人類創作」，也將成為文字浮水印技術除了準確率之外，仍需面對的問題。

items.title: 大摩示警：「2風險」恐推升通膨！Fed或迎新挑戰
paras: 美國通膨近期呈現降溫跡象，但宏觀經濟環境中仍潛藏一些力量，可能促使聯準會（Fed）將利率維持在較高水準更長時間。
根據《Business insider》報導，摩根士丹利首席美國經濟學家Michael T. Gapen週五在給客戶的報告中表示，核心消費者物價指數（CPI）數據顯示，通膨趨勢正在消退。
在他的團隊看來，這可能為聯準會保持耐心創造條件；聯準會在7月會議決定維持利率不變後，沒有必要急於採取利率行動。
不過，摩根士丹利的通膨預測建立在兩項重要假設上：

第一，近期供給面衝擊能夠完全消退，且不會出現新的供應衝擊；
第二，AI相關需求不會帶來顯著的價格壓力，包括記憶體與軟體價格上漲的直接影響，以及強勁需求帶動市場信心後產生的間接效應。


Gapen坦言，上述任何一項甚至兩項假設都有可能出錯，因此目前存在兩大通膨風險，分別是能源衝擊與AI熱潮。
其中，能源市場的變化已經影響美國通膨降溫速度。美國與伊朗的戰事導致全球能源流動受到歷史性干擾，美國家庭也承受相關成本。
Gapen指出，近期美伊關係再次升溫後，現貨與期貨能源價格均明顯上漲，使市場重新擔憂通膨壓力。
他表示，這項變化也逆轉了兩國簽署備忘錄後油價短暫下滑的趨勢，若能源市場進一步受到衝擊，可能增加聯準會在貨幣政策上的壓力。
除了能源之外，AI基礎建設投資熱潮也是Gapen關注的另一項風險。他與其他銀行業分析人士的看法一致，認為至少目前而言，AI並未成為推動通膨下降的力量。
Gapen指出，AI需求快速增加可能推升部分消費品價格，進而抵銷其他領域的通膨降溫效果。
以蘋果(AAPL-US) 為例，公司已調高部分裝置的價格，執行長庫克（Tim Cook）將此歸因於AI產業需求大增所造成的記憶體容量短缺。
在關稅影響方面，Gapen認為，關稅成本轉嫁大致已經完成，核心商品通膨將逐步接近「解放日」（Liberation Day）前的趨勢。
不過，他並不預期價格會完全回到原先水準，原因在於AI相關需求可能在未來幾季持續對電子產品價格形成上行壓力。

items.title: AI「偏空」隱憂現！美銀警告：基礎建設成本恐推升利率、使美股承壓
items.title_en: AI "Bearish" Risks Surface! Bank of America Warns Infrastructure Costs May Push Up Rates, Pressuring US Stocks
paras: 基於人工智慧（AI）能協助企業以更低成本提高產出、取代部分人力，進而降低薪資支出，AI長期被經濟學家與央行官員視為有助抑制通膨的新技術。然而，專家指出，這一切的發生可能還要「再等等」。
《Business Insider》報導指出，AI抑制通膨這項「長期利多」可能尚未到來。與此同時，AI基礎建設快速擴張所帶來的成本，反而已開始對物價形成上行壓力。
美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）報告於上週三（12日）公布後，相關跡象更加明顯。數據顯示，電腦價格單月上漲3.5%，軟體價格過去一年則大漲約40%。
美國銀行(BAC-US) 近日指出，再加上資料中心爭相取得電力所推升的能源成本，以及企業將AI導入成本轉嫁給消費者，AI開始呈現出推升通膨的特徵。
美銀經濟學家Stephen Juneau表示，AI不僅推高電子產品的投入成本，也正在帶來正向的財富效應，進而支撐消費需求。
他指出：「聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）一直強調的AI降通膨效應，恐怕還得再等一段時間。」
分析指出，這對股市來說，從兩方面都令人擔憂，包括短期與長期利率。
就殖利率曲線短端而言，AI推升通膨將使利率政策更加複雜。通膨越高，聯準會面臨的升息壓力就越大，可能進一步提高隔夜拆款利率。
報導指出，這將對經濟活動形成抑制，並可能拖慢企業獲利成長，而企業獲利正是支撐股市的重要因素。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye表示，AI基礎建設擴張不太可能造成一輪持續性的高通膨，但確實提高聯準會在9月會議上一次性升息的可能性。
另一方面，通膨升溫也可能推高長期債券殖利率。當投資人預期通膨將侵蝕資產實質價值，通常會要求更高的報酬率。
目前，美國10年期國債殖利率已升至4.64%，高於今年初的4.15%。
MRB Partners在一份給客戶的報告中表示，儘管影響長期利率的因素很多，但高額的投資支出正協助推升債券殖利率。該機構預期，長期殖利率仍將進一步走高，可能對股市造成不利影響。
MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Philip Colmar在報告中表示：「我們對美國國債的看空展望，最終將對美股構成問題。」
他進一步指出，自2020年以來，每當10年期美債殖利率出現明顯向上突破時，「股市都曾出現劇烈修正。」
paras_en: Based on AI’s ability to help companies increase output at lower cost and replace some labor, thereby reducing wage expenses, AI has long been seen by economists and central bankers as a new technology that could help curb inflation.
Business Insider reports that the long‑term inflation‑reducing benefit of AI may not have arrived yet, and the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is already creating upward price pressure.

After the US July Consumer Price Index report was released last Wednesday (the 12th), the signs became clearer, showing computer prices rose 3.5% month‑over‑month and software prices jumped about 40% over the past year.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) recently noted that rising energy costs from data centers scrambling for power and companies passing AI implementation costs onto consumers are giving AI an inflation‑raising character.
Bank of America economist Stephen Juneau said AI not only raises input costs for electronic products but also creates a positive wealth effect that supports consumer demand.
He added, “The Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s emphasis on AI’s deflationary impact may still require more time before it materializes.”
Analysts say this worries the stock market from two angles: short‑term and long‑term rates.

On the short end of the yield curve, AI‑driven inflation makes monetary policy more complex; higher inflation increases pressure on the Fed to raise rates, potentially lifting the overnight fed funds rate further.
The report notes this could dampen economic activity and slow corporate profit growth, which is a key driver of equity markets.

Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye said AI infrastructure expansion is unlikely to trigger a sustained high‑inflation episode but does raise the odds of a one‑time rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.
On the other hand, rising inflation could also push long‑term bond yields higher, as investors demand higher returns when they expect inflation to erode real asset values.
Currently, the US 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 4.64%, up from 4.15% at the start of the year.

MRB Partners told clients that although many factors affect long‑term rates, large investment outlays are helping lift bond yields, and the firm expects yields to keep rising, potentially hurting equities.
MRB Partners global strategy partner Philip Colmar said, “Our bearish outlook on US Treasuries will ultimately pose problems for US stocks.”
He further noted that since 2020, every time the 10‑year Treasury yield has made a clear upward breakout, the stock market has experienced a sharp correction.

items.title: 長鑫科技市值逼近英特爾！衝上5405億美元、超越騰訊、躋身全球第24大企業
items.title_en: Chingxin Technology's Market Value Approaches Intel's, Surpassing Tencent to Become the 24th Largest Global Enterprise
paras: 中國記憶體晶片大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 上市後股價持續攀升，市值迅速躋身全球最具價值企業之列。
根據《Business Insider》報導，長鑫科技上週五（14日）在上海科創板收盤上漲4%。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，長鑫科技市值達5,405億美元，僅次於市值5,526億美元的英特爾(INTC-US) ，並超越市值5,058億美元的中國科技巨頭騰訊(00700-HK) ，在LSEG全球企業市值排名中位居第24名。
長鑫科技市值快速攀升之際，英特爾股價上月受到整體晶片股遭遇拋售，以及市場對大規模人工智慧（AI）投資的疑慮影響而回落，使兩家公司之間的市值差距進一步縮小。
騰訊的市值同樣有所下滑。由於市場擔憂AI支出增加，以及AI可能對其軟體業務造成影響，騰訊在香港上市的股票今年以來已下跌約26%。
長鑫科技是中國最大的DRAM記憶體晶片生產商，總部位於中國東部安徽省。
該公司7月27日進行首次公開募股（IPO），募資約86億美元，上市首日股價即較IPO價格大漲466%，一舉成為中國上市公司中市值最高的企業。
Bernstein分析師近日在報告中指出，長鑫科技此次IPO為公司提供「更多現金用於資本支出」。
目前長鑫科技已是全球第4大DRAM生產商，排名僅次於三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與美光科技(MU-US) 。
野村證券上月預期，長鑫科技在全球DRAM產量中的占比，將從目前約10%提升至2028年底約18%。
paras_en: Chinese memory chip giant Chingxin Technology (688825-CN) has seen its stock price continue to rise after its listing, with its market value quickly joining the ranks of the world's most valuable companies.
According to a report by Business Insider, Chingxin Technology's stock price rose by 4% on Friday (14th) in the Shanghai Sci-Tech Innovation Board.

Based on data from the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), Chingxin Technology's market value has reached $540.5 billion, second only to Intel (INTC-US) with a market value of $552.6 billion, and surpassing Tencent (00700-HK) with a market value of $505.8 billion, ranking 24th in the LSEG global corporate market value rankings.

As Chingxin Technology's market value continues to rise rapidly, Intel's stock price fell last month due to the overall decline in chip stocks and market concerns about large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) investments, further narrowing the gap in market value between the two companies.

Tencent's market value has also declined, with its Hong Kong-listed stock falling by about 26% this year due to market concerns about increased AI spending and the potential impact on its software business.
Chingxin Technology is China's largest DRAM memory chip manufacturer, headquartered in Anhui Province, eastern China.

The company conducted its initial public offering (IPO) on July 27, raising approximately $8.6 billion, with its stock price surging 466% on the first day of listing, making it the Chinese listed company with the highest market value.
Bernstein analysts recently pointed out in a report that Chingxin Technology's IPO has provided the company with 'more cash for capital expenditures'.
Chingxin Technology is currently the world's fourth-largest DRAM producer, ranking behind Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS), and Micron Technology (MU-US).
Nomura Securities predicted last month that Chingxin Technology's share of global DRAM production would increase from around 10% to approximately 18% by the end of 2028.

items.title: 烏克蘭無人機猛攻 俄羅斯電商巨頭「野莓」七座物流中心停擺
items.title_en: Ukraine Drone Assault Halts Seven Logistics Centers of Russian E‑commerce Giant “Wildberries”
paras: 烏克蘭國防部16日（周日）通報，烏方已使俄羅斯大型電商平台「野莓」公司規模最大的10個物流中心中的7個停止運作。
烏克蘭國防部稱，在16日凌晨俄羅斯莫斯科州遭到大規模無人機襲擊後，除多莫傑多沃的「野莓」公司倉庫外，該公司位於「克列迪諾」工業園區的物流樞紐也停止運轉。
烏克蘭國防部表示，「克列迪諾」物流樞紐是「野莓」公司佔地面積最大的倉庫，面積達25萬平方公尺。
paras_en: Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence reported on Sunday the 16th that Ukrainian actions have forced seven of the ten largest logistics centres of the Russian e‑commerce platform Wildberries to cease operations.

The ministry said that after a massive drone strike hit Moscow Oblast in the early hours of the 16th, all Wildberries facilities except the warehouse in Domodedovo were shut down, and the logistics hub located in the Klyuchino industrial park also stopped functioning.
The ministry noted that the Klyuchino logistics hub is Wildberries’ largest warehouse, covering an area of 250,000 square metres.

items.title: 被「AI股神」爆倉拖累！Jane Street驚傳7月虧損150億美元
paras: 華爾街知名自營交易巨頭Jane Street罕見遭遇重大虧損。據多家媒體報導，Jane Street今年7月可能出現約150億美元虧損，若相關消息屬實，將是公司約10年來首次單月虧損。此次重創主要與其投資的人工智慧（AI）避險基金Situational Awareness爆倉，以及同期科技股劇烈波動有關。
值得注意的是，Jane Street遭遇巨額虧損之際，公司正同步推進一項約146億美元的債務再融資計畫，試圖透過發行新的私人債務，償還現有公開債券及浮動利率貸款，並將約110億美元的資本結構重新安排至私人投資人手中。
Pimco、Capital Group及Fidelity等大型機構均參與這項新債務融資。
此次虧損的主要導火線之一，是曾在今年上半年成為華爾街AI明星基金的Situational Awareness。
Situational Awareness由前OpenAI研究員Leopold Aschenbrenner創立，今年上半年大舉押注AI相關股票並取得可觀回報，基金資產規模也快速擴大。
然而，進入7月後，AI相關股票遭遇劇烈拋售，高槓桿部位迅速惡化，基金面臨追加保證金要求。
最終，Situational Awareness被迫大規模出售公開市場股票，並將大部分股票投資組合出售給億萬富豪Ken Griffin旗下的Citadel。基金遭遇的劇烈下跌，也直接波及包括Jane Street在內的投資人。
Jane Street在內部備忘錄中承認，由於Situational Awareness上半年表現突出，公司此前持續增加對該基金的投資。但隨著基金大幅回撤，Jane Street目前持有的這項投資已「基本回到年初的水準」，不過從整體投資週期來看仍處於獲利狀態。
不過，Situational Awareness並非Jane Street此次巨額虧損的唯一原因。
《路透》援引Jane Street內部備忘錄指出，公司在亞洲非AI股票上的多頭部位同樣遭遇損失，而這些股票此前也曾是今年表現較好的資產。
Jane Street表示，公司很大程度上是在同一組交易組合上出現虧損，而這些交易在第二季曾創造強勁的超額報酬。
公司並指出，7月AI曝險股票大幅下跌，其中部分曝險程度較高的記憶體晶片與半導體股票，跌幅約達50%。
因此，此次虧損反映出的並非單一基金爆倉，而是Jane Street先前表現優異的交易部位，在市場風格快速轉變後出現集中回撤。

7月虧損150億美元　Jane Street年內交易收入仍超400億美元

儘管7月遭遇重大打擊，Jane Street整體交易業務今年仍維持強勁表現。
《彭博》與《路透》引述知情人士指出，Jane Street今年以來的淨交易收入仍超過400億美元，不僅已超越公司2025年創下紀錄的396億美元全年交易收入，也高於華爾街大型銀行及其他主要做市商同期的交易收入。
因此，儘管150億美元級別的單月虧損規模罕見，但目前仍不足以代表Jane Street核心業務模式受到破壞。
Jane Street目前的應對方式也並非全面收縮交易，而是針對此次虧損暴露出的風險進行調整。
公司在內部備忘錄中表示，未來將對風險承擔採取「更加有選擇性」的方式，並已關閉相當一部分在7月造成虧損的特定風險曝險，同時降低其他交易策略的風險承擔。

Jane Street推進146億美元債務再融資

就在巨額虧損消息傳出的同時，Jane Street也正在進行大規模債務重組。
《金融時報》報導，Jane Street本週推進約146億美元的債務融資，由摩根大通牽頭，交易分為3批債券，Pimco、Capital Group及Fidelity等大型機構投資人均參與其中。
這項交易主要是重新調整Jane Street的融資結構。公司計畫利用新的私人債務，償還浮動利率貸款及現有公開債券，將更多債務轉移至私人市場。
對高度重視交易策略與財務資訊保密性的自營交易公司而言，這項融資安排也具有特殊意義。
《金融時報》指出，Jane Street甚至願意承擔較高融資成本，以換取降低公開資訊揭露程度。此次再融資預計將產生數億美元的一次性成本，而新的債務融資成本也高於過去的公開市場融資。

AI基金爆倉凸顯槓桿交易風險

Situational Awareness事件的影響並不僅限於單一基金的投資損失，其背後也反映出現代主經紀商體系中的風險傳導機制。
當高槓桿AI投資遭遇股價下跌時，基金可能面臨追加保證金要求，進而被迫出售持股；主經紀商則可能同步收縮風險曝險，進一步促使大量資產被拋售。
Situational Awareness的交易由多家大型銀行提供融資及主經紀服務。先前報導指出，美國銀行、高盛及摩根大通等機構均參與相關融資體系。隨著AI股票價格快速下跌，主經紀商要求基金補充抵押品，最終促使基金大規模出售股票投資組合。
而Citadel以折價價格接手大量股票，則成為這一市場結構中的另一環。當高槓桿機構被迫出售資產時，擁有充足資本與流動性的交易機構可以承接折價資產。
先前報導指出，Citadel旗下股票基金7月上漲約14%，部分原因就是以折價價格接手Situational Awareness的股票組合，而相關AI股票之後出現反彈。

Jane Street開始收縮部分風險部位

對於過去多年持續創造盈利紀錄的Jane Street而言，7月的巨額虧損也促使公司重新調整風險承擔。
Jane Street合夥人Batty在內部備忘錄中表示，公司已關閉相當一部分在7月造成損失的特定風險曝險，同時降低其他策略的風險承擔。
不過，他也指出，目前公司的持倉與當前風險承受能力相符，市場交易量依然強勁，短週期交易策略的盈利能力也持續改善。
這顯示Jane Street目前並未將7月虧損視為核心交易模式失效，而是針對近期暴露出的風險進行調整。
分析指出，隨著AI相關交易在資本市場持續受到高度關注，Jane Street此次巨額虧損，也讓外界重新聚焦於AI資產波動、槓桿部位及交易機構風險管理之間的關聯。

items.title: 美國太空採購改制衝擊營收，York能見度下降、全年財測下修32%
items.title_en: U.S. Space Procurement Reform Hits Revenue, York's Visibility Drops, Full-Year Forecast Cut by 32%
paras: 2026年08月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國政府持續擴大太空領域的投資，但衛星製造商York Space Systems(YSS-US)卻將2026年營收預估中位數由5.7億美元降至3.9億美元，下修1.8億美元、幅度約32%。原因不是政府減少採購，而是採購方式從直接招標大型專案，改為先建立合格供應商名單，再逐案發出任務訂單。
這項改變拉長York從入選供應商到取得實際訂單的時間，也讓原本預計今年取得並認列的新業務延後至2027年。公司追蹤的商機雖超過115億美元，潛在未授予合約達18.5億美元，但第2季積壓訂單仍季減8%至5.92億美元，反映商機尚未轉成正式訂單。

從一次取得大型合約，改成兩階段採購
美國政府過去通常直接針對大型衛星或太空系統招標。York得標後即可投入設計與生產，並隨著專案執行逐步認列收入。
現在政府逐漸改採IDIQ模式，將採購拆成兩個階段。第一階段先選出合格供應商，第二階段等需求明確後，再向入選公司發出具有實際金額與工作內容的任務訂單。
對政府而言，IDIQ建立完成後，可依照不同需求快速下單，不必每次重新進行完整招標。但對York而言，入選IDIQ只代表取得未來競標資格，並不等於已經拿到訂單，因此更難預估合約金額與營收認列時間。

入選9.81億美元合約池，不等於取得9.81億美元訂單
美國太空軍建立的NITE-STAR IDIQ，就是這種新採購模式的例子。合約總額上限為9.81億美元，涵蓋兩個五年下單期，用於太空測試、訓練、技術開發及系統整合。
York與波音、洛克希德馬丁、Northrop Grumman及Rocket Lab等15家公司共同入選。然而，9.81億美元是整個合約池的採購上限，不是York已取得的訂單，也不是由15家公司平均分配。
York必須等待太空軍提出具體需求，再與其他入選廠商競爭任務訂單。最終收入取決於訂單何時釋出、規模多大，以及York能取得多少份額。

新業務延後，幾乎解釋全部財測下修
York原先預估2026年營收約5.7億美元，其中約30%、相當於1.71億美元，來自尚未取得的新業務。公司原本假設今年能拿到部分大型合約，並在專案啟動後開始認列收入。
但政府優先建立IDIQ合約池，大型專案沒有依照原先預期直接招標。York因此將今年尚未取得的新業務收入全部移出財測，使全年營收預估降至3.75億至4.05億美元，中位數減少1.8億美元。
公司今年雖已取得8項合約，提案得標率達88%，其中6項來自新採購模式，但目前多數仍是供應商資格、示範案或初期任務，尚未進入大規模部署。

2027年能否拿到大型任務訂單是關鍵
York認為，收入只是由2026年延後至2027年，並非政府需求消失。IDIQ平台完成後，政府確實可以更快發出後續任務訂單，但大型訂單的時間與金額仍不確定。
因此，超過115億美元的商機不能直接視為未來營收。York必須先從合約池取得具體任務訂單，再由小型測試進入大規模部署，收入才會真正增加。
後續重點不是York又入選多少個IDIQ，而是政府何時開始發出大型任務訂單，以及York能從15家甚至更多合格供應商中分到多少。若訂單在2027年快速落地，今年減少的收入才可能補回；若採購時程繼續延後，公司的營收能見度仍會偏低。

paras_en: On August 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — The U.S. government continues to expand investment in the space sector, but satellite manufacturer York Space Systems (YSS‑US) has lowered its 2026 revenue median estimate from $570 million to $390 million, a reduction of $180 million or about 32%. The cause is not a cut in government purchases, but a shift in procurement from direct large‑project tenders to first establishing a qualified supplier list and then issuing task orders case by case.

This change lengthens the time for York to move from being selected as a supplier to securing actual orders, pushing new business that was expected to be booked and recognized this year into 2027. While the company tracks opportunities exceeding $11.5 billion, with $1.85 billion of potential contracts not yet awarded, its Q2 backlog fell 8% quarter‑over‑quarter to $592 million, indicating that the pipeline has not yet turned into firm orders.

From winning a single large contract to a two‑stage procurement The U.S. government previously tended to issue direct tenders for large satellites or space systems. Once York won a contract, it could begin design and production and recognize revenue progressively as the project proceeded.

Now the government is gradually adopting an IDIQ model, splitting procurement into two phases. In the first phase, qualified suppliers are selected; in the second phase, once requirements are clear, task orders with specific dollar amounts and work scopes are issued to the selected firms.

For the government, an IDIQ framework allows rapid ordering for varying needs without conducting a full tender each time. For York, being selected for an IDIQ only secures future competition eligibility and does not guarantee an order, making it harder to forecast contract values and revenue timing.

Being selected for a $981 million contract pool does not equal receiving a $981 million order The NITE‑STAR IDIQ established by the U.S. Space Force exemplifies this new procurement style. The contract pool has a ceiling of $981 million covering two five‑year ordering periods for space testing, training, technology development, and system integration.

York was chosen together with Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Rocket Lab and 10 other companies. However, the $981 million is the total procurement limit for the pool, not an order already secured by York nor an amount to be split evenly among the 15 firms.

York must wait for the Space Force to issue specific requirements and then compete with the other selected vendors for task orders. Final revenue will depend on when orders are released, their size, and the share York can capture.

The delayed new business almost fully explains the forecast cut York originally projected 2026 revenue of about $570 million, with roughly 30%—or $171 million—coming from yet‑to‑be‑won new business. The company had assumed it would secure part of a large contract this year and begin recognizing revenue once the project started.

But the government prioritized building the IDIQ pool, and large projects were not tendered directly as originally expected. Consequently, York removed all projected revenue from unawarded new business from its outlook, lowering the full‑year revenue estimate to $375 million‑$405 million, a median reduction of $180 million.

The company has already secured eight contracts this year, achieving an 88% proposal win rate, with six of them stemming from the new procurement model. Most of these are still supplier qualifications, demonstration projects, or early‑stage tasks and have not yet moved into large‑scale deployment.

Whether York can obtain large task orders in 2027 is critical York believes the revenue will simply be shifted from 2026 to 2027 rather than disappearing due to lack of demand. Once the IDIQ platform is in place, the government can indeed issue follow‑on task orders more quickly, but the timing and size of large orders remain uncertain.

Thus, the $11.5 billion of opportunities cannot be directly treated as future revenue. York must first win concrete task orders from the contract pool, then scale from small tests to full‑scale deployment before revenue truly rises.

The next focus is not how many additional IDIQs York gets selected for, but when the government starts issuing large task orders and how much York can capture out of the 15—or potentially more—qualified suppliers. If orders materialize quickly in 2027, this year’s revenue shortfall could be recovered; if procurement timelines keep slipping, the company’s revenue visibility will remain low.

items.title: 常春藤名校太空豪賭！哈佛揭露22億美元SpaceX倉位
items.title_en: Ivy League Power Play: Harvard Reveals $2.2 Billion Stake in SpaceX
paras: 美國常春藤名校哈佛大學押注SpaceX(SPCX-US) ，一筆早年風險投資變成哈佛最大單一股票頭寸。
哈佛大學投資管理公司（Harvard Management Company）在14日（周五）提交的監管文件中揭露，持有SpaceX股份價值22億美元，在哈佛43億美元美股投資組合中位居第一，超過其他所有單一股票持倉。
這筆持倉並非近期建倉，而是哈佛透過風險投資基金對SpaceX進行早期投資的結果——部分布局距今已逾十年。
SpaceX今年6月完成上市，創下紀錄，這批早年入場的大學捐贈基金由此獲得可觀賬面回報。
大學捐贈基金投資SpaceX的路徑與普通股票投資者不同。
SpaceX在上市前長期以私募形式營運，外部機構主要透過參與風險投資基金間接持股。哈佛的22億美元持倉，可能同時包含直接持有股份，以及透過私募基金分配所得股票。
這種結構意味著，哈佛的實際入場成本遠低於135美元發行價。SpaceX上市後的股價漲幅，直接放大了這筆投資的賬面價值。
截至2025年6月，哈佛管理公司管理的資產總規模約570億美元。22億美元的SpaceX持倉，約佔其整體資產3.9%。
據《Fox Business》報導，加州大學投資部門上周同樣提交了監管文件，揭露持有SpaceX股份約10億美元。北卡羅來納大學和聖路易斯華盛頓大學也持有SpaceX股票。
多所頂尖大學同步揭露持倉，折射出一個共同邏輯：過去十年間，大學捐贈基金普遍加大了對風險投資的配置，而SpaceX正是核心標的之一。目前SpaceX整體估值超過1.8兆美元。
paras_en: Harvard University has made a significant bet on SpaceX (SPCX-US), with a stake worth $2.2 billion, making it the university's largest single stock holding.

According to a regulatory filing submitted by Harvard Management Company on Friday, the university holds a 22 billion dollar stake in SpaceX, making it the largest single stock holding in its 4.3 billion dollar US stock portfolio.
This holding is not a recent development, but rather the result of Harvard's early investment in SpaceX through a risk investment fund, with some of the allocation dating back over a decade.
SpaceX went public in June, setting a record, and this early investment has resulted in a significant return on investment for the university's endowment fund.
The university's investment in SpaceX differs from that of ordinary stock investors.

SpaceX operated in private form for a long time before going public, and external institutions mainly held shares through participating in risk investment funds. Harvard's 2.2 billion dollar stake may include both directly held shares and shares distributed through private funds.
This structure means that Harvard's actual entry cost was significantly lower than the 135 dollar issue price. The subsequent stock price increase has amplified the value of this investment.
As of June 2025, Harvard Management Company managed assets totaling approximately 5.7 billion dollars. The 2.2 billion dollar SpaceX stake accounts for about 3.9% of its total assets.

According to a report by Fox Business, the investment department of the University of California submitted a similar regulatory filing last week, revealing a 1 billion dollar stake in SpaceX. The University of North Carolina and Washington University in St. Louis also hold SpaceX shares.

Several top universities have simultaneously disclosed their holdings, reflecting a common logic: over the past decade, university endowment funds have generally increased their allocation to risk investments, with SpaceX being a core target. SpaceX's total valuation currently exceeds 1.8 trillion dollars.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：Fed會議記錄、各國PMI初值、日GDP與通膨數據
paras: 未來一周，市場目光將集中在聯準會(Fed)會議紀錄、各國標普全球採購經理人指數(PMI)初值及零售巨頭財報，市場將仔細分析Fed訊號及沃爾瑪等零售業風向球的業績，以評估消費者信心與貨幣政策走向。與此同時，投資人將持續關注石油價格與中東局勢發展，期盼美伊達成協議並重新開啟荷姆茲海峽。此前，華府最新表態將繼續加大對伊朗經濟施壓。
歐洲央行也將公佈會議記錄，歐元區，英國和加拿大通膨和零售銷售數據，德國ZEW經濟景氣指數亦將陸續登場。此外，市場還將聚焦日本第2季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值和全國通膨數據，以及中國工業生產、零售銷售和房價數據。
1. Fed會議紀錄
美國聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月會議紀錄將於週三(19日)公佈，當中可能包含9月是否升息線索。美國非農就業數據表現弱於預期及通膨略降，導致市場降低Fed升息預期。根據LSEG數據，目前美國貨幣市場認為下月升息1碼機率僅27%，升息預期要到明年初才能完全反映市場情緒。

儘管如此，上月FOMC以9比3投票結果決定將聯邦基金利率維持在3.5%至3.75%的區間，3名委員持不同意見。Capital.com資深市場分析師Daniela Hathorn在最新研報中寫道：「週三FOMC會議記錄將受到密切關注，以了解聯準會內部分歧程度。近期疲弱的美國就業和生產者物價數據，以及消費者物價指數(CPI)通膨相對溫和，都強化可以保持耐心並暫時維持利率不變的觀點。然而，通膨情況並非完全樂觀。CPI正朝向正確方向發展，但仍高於目標水平，長債殖利率也居高不下。」
2. 各國PMI初值
包括美國、歐元區、德國、法國、英國與義大利在內主要經濟體的製造業和服務業PMI初值將提供區域經濟活動和價格壓力的最新資訊。Investec分析師Lottie Gosling在最新研究報告中寫道：「由於美國和伊朗在荷姆茲海峽的持續僵局再次推高油氣價格，歐元區PMI將會下跌。」
德國8月ZEW經濟景氣指數將於週二(18日)公佈，該指數上月創5個月新高。隔日，歐元區6月國際收支數據與7月CPI數據亦將出爐。英國通膨、勞動市場和零售銷售及PMI初值也分別將在週二、週三與週五(21日)發布。
3. 中國經濟數據與利率決議
中國將於週一(17日)公佈一系列的7月經濟數據，包括工業生產、零售銷售、固定資產投資和房價，這些數據將反映中國經濟在第三季初的運作狀況。經濟學家預估大多數指標將表現疲軟，這一結果將增強市場對更多政策支持的預期。此外，中國央行週四(20日)將公布貸款市場報價利率(LPR)決議，1年期與5年期以上LPR預計將分別維持在3%與3.5%不變。
高盛經濟學家預估，工業生產數據將反映出口成長放緩、製造業活動疲軟及鋼鐵生產和需求的更大幅度萎縮。儘管「以舊換新」政策帶來的提振作用正在減弱，但零售銷售數據江得利於低基期效應而走升。滙豐銀行經濟學家則認為，FAI(第一投資指數)數據將顯示房地產仍是主要拖累因素，製造業投資恐續呈K型復甦。
4. 日GDP與通膨數據
市場普遍預期，日本週一公布的第二季GDP初值將季增0.5%，表現持平，民間消費可望維持在經濟成長的主要引擎地位。此外，週五出爐的CPI與核心CPI料將分別溫和走升至年增2%與1.8%，整體通膨率預計加速回升，睽違數個月首次重返日本央行(BOJ)2%目標，主要受到進口物價持續上漲的壓力推動。
BOJ預計將在週三購買多個期限的債券，包括1-3年期、5-10年期和25年以上的債券。巴克萊銀行策略師表示，隔夜指數互換市場「已充分消化日本央行進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期，1.75%的最終利率及10月前進一步升息的預期實際上已被完全消化」。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元因降息預期升溫走低 本周仍終結連兩周跌勢
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Falls as Rate‑Cut Expectations Rise, Ending Two‑Week Decline This Week
paras: 美元周五(14日)走低，最新公布的經濟數據進一步促使市場重新調整對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。不過，受中東外交僵局推升油價，進而增加避險需求的帶動，美元本周仍終結連續兩周跌勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報99.67。本周上漲約0.1%。
這周市場主要關注美國關鍵通膨數據，以及周五公布的零售銷售數據，以尋找貨幣政策走向的線索。這些數據顯示價格壓力正在降溫、消費支出也有所放緩，加上上周公布的就業報告意外疲弱，使聯準會立即收緊貨幣政策的壓力有所減輕。
周三公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示，7月整體及核心通膨年增率均放緩。周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)也呈現類似趨勢，整體及核心指數年增速度均較為溫和。
美國人口普查局周五表示，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，至7,636億美元，遠低於市場預期的成長0.1%。核心零售銷售則月減0.3%，市場原先預期成長0.2%。
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams表示，「隨著汽油及其他能源價格上漲推高生活成本，消費者減少了非必要支出。6月個人儲蓄率更降至2022年年中以來最低水準。」
他指出，「細項數據其實沒有整體數字看起來那麼糟。加油站銷售下滑其實是好消息，因為這反映價格下降。此外，亞馬遜Prime Day今年提前至6月底舉行，而不是像去年一樣在7月舉行，也導致非店面零售銷售疲弱。但即使排除這些一次性因素，零售支出上個月仍然下滑。」
市場也相應調整了對聯準會利率走向的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率已升至約67%，高於一周前的近56%。升息1碼的機率則從一周前約44%降至接近33%。
Adams補充，「7月疲弱的零售銷售數據進一步降低了聯準會在9月下一次會議升息的機率。」
在CPI及PPI數據公布後，對利率敏感的美國公債殖利率周三、周四走低，因交易員大量買進債券。殖利率周五反彈，使10年期美債殖利率本周轉為上漲。不過，短天期的2年期美債殖利率本周仍下跌。
這周經濟數據對美元構成壓力，但油價上漲則抵銷了部分影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲1.7%，至每桶88.52美元，本周累計上漲4.5%。
油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗就關鍵水道荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權陷入僵局的影響。雙方均各自宣稱擁有這條重要水道的控制權，而德黑蘭則堅持華盛頓必須滿足包括停止各戰線敵對行動，以及解凍伊朗資產等要求，荷姆茲海峽才能重新開放。
美國目前正考慮無限期維持對伊朗的海上封鎖，結束衝突並恢復海峽正常航運的努力仍陷入停滯。通過這條航線的油輪數量已大幅減少，引發市場對石油供應中斷的擔憂。此外，伊朗支持的葉門「青年運動」(Houthis)在另一條重要海灣航運通道——曼德海峽(Bab el-Mandeb Strait)發動的船隻襲擊，進一步加劇相關疑慮。
日元本周貶值1%
其他主要貨幣方面，日元週五走強，但本周兌美元仍貶值約1%。
在華盛頓與東京於上月底進行歷史性聯合干預後，日元未能守住相關漲幅，近兩周持續兌美元走弱。
另一方面，歐元與英鎊本周均上漲，前者目前周漲幅為0.1%，後者上漲約0.3%。

paras_en: The dollar slipped on Friday (the 14th), as the latest economic data prompted the market to revise its expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. However, higher oil prices driven by a diplomatic deadlock in the Middle East boosted safe‑haven demand, allowing the dollar to break its two‑week losing streak this week.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 99.67, up about 0.1% for the week.

This week the market focused on key U.S. inflation figures and Friday’s retail sales data to gauge the direction of monetary policy. The numbers showed cooling price pressure and a slowdown in consumer spending, and together with last week’s unexpectedly weak jobs report, eased pressure on the Fed to tighten policy immediately.

Wednesday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed that both headline and core inflation year‑over‑year rates slowed in July. Thursday’s Producer Price Index (PPI) displayed a similar trend, with overall and core indices posting modest year‑over‑year growth.

The U.S. Census Bureau reported on Friday that July retail sales fell 0.6% month‑over‑month to $763.6 billion, far below the market’s expectation of a 0.1% increase. Core retail sales dropped 0.3% month‑over‑month, versus an anticipated 0.2% rise.

Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, said, “Higher gasoline and other energy prices have pushed up living costs, prompting consumers to cut back on non‑essential spending. The personal savings rate fell in June to its lowest level since mid‑2022.”

He added, “The granular data aren’t as bad as the headline numbers suggest. The decline in gas‑station sales is actually good news because it reflects lower prices. Amazon’s Prime Day was moved up to the end of June this year instead of July, which also contributed to weaker non‑store retail sales. Even after stripping out these one‑off factors, retail spending still fell last month.”

The market also adjusted its expectations for Fed rate moves. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September has risen to about 67%, up from roughly 56% a week earlier. The odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike fell from about 44% to near 33% over the same period.
Adams further noted, “Weak July retail sales data further reduce the likelihood of a rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.”

After the CPI and PPI releases, yields on rate‑sensitive U.S. Treasuries fell on Wednesday and Thursday as traders bought bonds in large volumes. Yields rebounded on Friday, turning the 10‑year Treasury yield into a weekly gain, while the short‑term two‑year yield continued to decline for the week.
This week’s economic data put pressure on the dollar, but the rise in oil prices offset part of that impact. Brent crude futures were up 1.7% at $88.52 a barrel, a weekly gain of 4.5%.

The oil price increase was mainly driven by a stalemate between the United States and Iran over control of the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Both sides claim authority over the waterway, and Tehran insists Washington must meet demands—including halting hostile actions on all fronts and unfreezing Iranian assets—before the strait can be reopened.

The United States is currently considering an indefinite maritime blockade of Iran, and efforts to end the conflict and restore normal shipping through the strait have stalled. The number of tankers using the route has dropped sharply, raising concerns about oil‑supply disruptions. In addition, Iran‑backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have attacked vessels in another key shipping lane, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, further heightening worries.
The yen depreciated about 1% this week.
Among other major currencies, the yen strengthened on Friday but still ended the week down roughly 1% against the dollar.
After a historic joint intervention by Washington and Tokyo at the end of last month, the yen failed to hold its gains and has weakened against the dollar for nearly two consecutive weeks.
Conversely, both the euro and the pound rose this week, with the euro up about 0.1% on a weekly basis and the pound gaining roughly 0.3%.

items.title_en: Trump Administration Acts Again! U.S. Demands EU Dismantle Sustainability Regulations and Other Non‑Tariff Barriers
paras: 美國周五(14日)再度向歐盟施壓，要求放寬企業永續與碳排相關法規，並履行先前承諾，確保這些規定不會對歐美貿易造成不當限制。不過，歐盟強調自身監管自主權不容談判，顯示雙方在關稅協議生效後，角力焦點正轉向非關稅貿易壁壘。
美國駐歐盟大使普茲德(Andrew Puzder)在社群平台X發文表示，歐盟應履行2025年7月在蘇格蘭坦伯利與美國總統川普進行貿易談判時作出的承諾。根據雙方架構協議，歐盟承諾確保《企業永續盡職調查指令》(CSDDD)與《企業永續報告指令》(CSRD)不會對跨大西洋貿易構成不當限制。
普茲德指出，這些法規的域外適用條款將損害美國企業與勞工，受影響的也不會只有美國。相關規定要求在歐盟營運的大型企業，包括美國公司，揭露其全球供應鏈對環境與社會造成的影響，其中涵蓋碳排放及勞動條件。
歐盟執委會發言人回應，美歐仍在就關稅與非關稅議題進行協商，歐盟也已向美方說明相關規範，並願意合作擴大雙邊貿易。不過，發言人強調，歐盟的法規架構及監管自主權均「不在談判範圍內」。
除企業永續規定外，華盛頓也要求歐盟修改碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)。該制度對未達歐盟碳排標準的進口商品徵收費用，美方認為這可能使美國出口商承受額外負擔。
知情人士預期，美歐可能在今年秋季發表聯合聲明，處理坦伯利協議中的非關稅議題。歐盟過去一年已放寬部分遭美方批評的政策，包括反森林砍伐法規及甲烷排放規定，但熟悉歐盟立場的人士表示，布魯塞爾目前無意進一步讓步。
歐盟去年也因企業與美國、卡達等政府反彈，縮減企業永續法規的適用範圍。去年12月通過的修正案將CSDDD限縮至最大型企業，合規期限延後兩年至2029年中；CSRD則僅適用於員工超過1,000人的企業，門檻遠高於原先的250人。
包括艾克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的美國企業仍要求更大幅度調整，甚至主張全面豁免外國公司。美方表示，雖肯定歐盟去年12月永續法規整合修正案的部分改革，但相關措施仍未充分解決美國對這兩項指令的疑慮。
paras_en: The United States pressed the EU again on Friday the 14th, demanding that it ease corporate sustainability and carbon‑related regulations and honor its earlier pledge to ensure those rules do not create undue restrictions on trans‑Atlantic trade. The EU, however, stressed that its regulatory autonomy is non‑negotiable, indicating that after the tariff agreement takes effect the focus of the dispute is shifting to non‑tariff trade barriers.

U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder posted on X that the EU must fulfill the commitment made in July 2025 during trade talks with President Trump in Tanfield, Scotland. Under the framework agreement, the EU pledged to ensure that the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD) and the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) will not constitute improper constraints on trans‑Atlantic commerce.

Puzder warned that the extraterritorial provisions of these regulations would harm U.S. companies and workers, and the impact would not be limited to the United States. The rules require large firms operating in the EU, including U.S. firms, to disclose the environmental and social impacts of their global supply chains, covering carbon emissions and labour conditions.

An EU Commission spokesperson responded that the U.S. and EU are still negotiating tariff and non‑tariff issues, that the EU has explained the relevant rules to Washington and is willing to cooperate to expand bilateral trade. However, the spokesperson stressed that the EU’s regulatory framework and supervisory autonomy are “outside the scope of negotiations.”

Beyond corporate sustainability rules, Washington also wants the EU to modify its Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). That system levies fees on imported goods that do not meet EU carbon‑emission standards, which the U.S. says could impose extra burdens on American exporters.

Informed sources expect the U.S. and EU may issue a joint statement this autumn to address the non‑tariff issues in the Tanfield agreement. Over the past year the EU has eased some policies criticized by the U.S., such as anti‑deforestation rules and methane‑emission standards, but insiders say Brussels is currently unwilling to make further concessions.

The EU also scaled back the scope of its corporate sustainability regulations last year after pushback from the United States, Qatar and other governments. An amendment passed in December limited the CSDDD to the largest firms, pushing the compliance deadline back two years to mid‑2029, while the CSRD now applies only to companies with more than 1,000 employees, a threshold far higher than the original 250‑employee benchmark.

U.S. firms, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), continue to demand far greater adjustments and even argue for a full exemption for foreign companies. The U.S. acknowledges some of the reforms in the EU’s December 2023 sustainability‑law integration amendment but says the measures still do not adequately address American concerns over the two directives.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

Meanwhile, stalled US‑Iran peace efforts could curb demand, pushing oil prices lower and weighing on the dollar. On Thursday, BOJ data showed Japan's July corporate goods price index (CGPI) up 0.1% month‑over‑month and 7.2% year‑over‑year, missing expectations but still high, indicating rising inflation pressure and fueling speculation of a September BOJ hike. Bloomberg cited insiders saying Prime Minister Kishida’s government backs a near‑term hike, reflecting US Treasury Secretary Yellen’s push after joint intervention for Japan to adopt tighter policy, hinting a shift from dovish stance and allowing BOJ rate hikes. The yield spread between Japanese and US Treasuries is expected to narrow further, providing support for the yen.

Subsequently, the US Labor Department reported initial jobless claims rising to 209,000. July’s final PPI held steady month‑over‑month and fell to 4.7% year‑over‑year, bolstering expectations the Fed will hold rates steady next month. Richmond Fed President Barkin said cooling inflation reduces the need for hikes, pushing the dollar‑yen down to a low of 159.01, while Cleveland Fed President Harker reiterated that the Fed should raise rates promptly to curb inflation. Fitch affirmed the US AA+ sovereign rating with a stable outlook, and volatile Middle‑East tensions lifted the dollar‑yen to a high of 159.56. The dollar‑yen is projected to find support at 158.90‑159.10 and face resistance at 159.70‑159.90 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) saw one‑year and two‑year inflation expectations unexpectedly fall to 2.6% and 2.34% respectively. Markets are betting roughly an 80% chance of an RBNZ rate hike at its early‑September meeting. RBA Assistant Deputy Governor Kent said the three earlier hikes this year are starting to have the intended effect, but inflation risks remain upside‑biased, leaving room for further tightening. Compared with market‑driven expectations of a near‑term US policy tightening slowdown, this supports the Aussie and Kiwi. However, Germany’s monthly economic report noted persistently high corporate bankruptcies, dragging the euro‑dollar down to a low of 1.1510.

According to Reuters polling, the European Central Bank is expected to deliver its final hike next month, potentially the shortest tightening cycle in fifteen years. Yet data show Spain’s July CPI and HICP rising to 3.6% and 3.9% year‑over‑year, and Euro‑area June industrial production growing 0.1% above expectations, spurring the euro‑dollar back up to a high of 1.1545. The euro‑dollar is projected to face resistance at 1.1535‑1.1555 and support at 1.1450‑1.1470 today.
GBP/USD

On Thursday, a Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) survey showed the UK house‑price index gap widening to –30 in July. UK Office for National Statistics data indicated that, helped by a temporary pause in soaring energy prices, the World Cup and hot weather, June GDP grew 0.3% month‑over‑month, positioning the UK to potentially be the strongest G7 economy in the first half of the year and lifting the pound‑dollar to a high of 1.3512. Later, BOE chief economist Peel told the Wall Street Journal that the UK’s growth provides a case for further rate hikes, but Middle‑East tensions are supporting the dollar, pulling the pound‑dollar down to a low of 1.3471. The pound‑dollar is expected to face resistance at 1.3500‑1.3520 and support at 1.3410‑1.3430 today.

items.title_en: NY Forex: PPI Flat Eases Fed Rate‑Hike Bets, Dollar Mixed vs Major Currencies
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周四(13日)漲跌互見，最新數據顯示美國生產者價格指數(PPI)持平，使交易員進一步下修聯準會(Fed)9月升息的機率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)微漲0.02%，約報99.96。PPI公布前報99.80。
美國7月PPI持平，低於市場所估的攀升0.2%，6月數據修正為下滑0.1%。
道富(State Street)資深總經策略師Noel Dixon說，本月稍晚另將公布個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，從組成PCE的項目來看，這份報告「應該會相當不錯」。
他說：「我從這個數字和昨天的數字中得出的結論是，這有助於證明Fed在9月維持利率不變的合理性。」
聯邦資金利率期貨顯示，Fed 9月升息機率為35%，低於周三的40%和一周前的55%。
美元兌歐元略升0.03%至1.1528。
交易員一直在觀察Fed是否需要升息，以抑制目前仍持續高於2%目標的通膨綠，同時，伊朗對荷姆茲海峽的掌控仍在牽動油價。
稍早有報導披露，葉門青年運動(Houthis)無人機鎖定了沙烏地阿拉伯石油公司(Saudi Aramco)的煉油廠，國際油價周四稍早一度上漲逾3%，但之後收復部分失土，跌幅收斂至不到1%。
美國周四公布的其他數據顯示，上周首次申請失業救濟金的人數微幅增加，代表儘管7月非農就業人口意外減少，勞動力市場依然穩定。周五將公布的離零售數據將再次呈現美國經濟的強弱。
日元兌美元微貶0.04%至159.48。目前日元已經回吐上個月美日歷史性聯合干預帶來的部分漲幅。當時的干預行動曾讓市場加碼押注日本銀行(央行，BOJ)可能需要加速進一步升息。
Dixon說：「我不認為這已經嚇退投資人繼續押注日元走弱，除非日銀在9月會議上採取行動，並釋出更偏鷹派的政策指引。」
英鎊下跌0.08%至1.3481美元。英國經濟6月意外成長0.3%，主要受能源價格下滑、世界盃開打及炎熱天氣帶動。
挪威克朗走弱，報9.51美元。先前挪威央行如市場預期維持利率不變，但同時表示近期通膨已有所降溫。
挪威目前利率為4.25%，在全球10個已開發經濟體中名列前茅，加上挪威身為石油與天然氣出口國，今年以來也受到油氣產業支撐，帶動挪威克朗走強。

paras_en: The dollar was mixed against major currencies on Thursday (the 13th) as the latest data showed the U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) held steady, prompting traders to further lower the probability of a Fed rate hike in September.
In the New York close, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, edged up 0.02% to about 99.96, after standing at 99.80 before the PPI release.
July's U.S. PPI was flat, below the market’s expectation of a 0.2% rise, and June’s data were revised to a 0.1% decline.

State Street senior chief economist Noel Dixon said that later this month the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index will be released, and based on its components the report “should be fairly solid.”
He added, “My takeaway from this number and yesterday’s figure is that it supports the case for the Fed keeping rates unchanged in September.”
Federal funds futures show a 35% chance of a September Fed hike, down from 40% on Wednesday and 55% a week earlier.
The dollar was up 0.03% against the euro, trading at 1.1528.
Traders have been watching whether the Fed needs to raise rates to curb inflation that remains above the 2% target, while Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait continues to influence oil prices.

Earlier reports disclosed that Houthi drones targeted a Saudi Aramco refinery; international oil prices rose more than 3% on Thursday before retracing some gains and ending with a decline of less than 1%.

Other U.S. data released on Thursday showed a slight increase in initial unemployment claims, indicating that despite an unexpected drop in July non‑farm payrolls, the labor market remains stable. Retail data due on Friday will again test the strength of the U.S. economy.

The yen slipped 0.04% to 159.48 per dollar. It has given back part of the gains from last month’s historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention, which had led markets to bet that the Bank of Japan might need to accelerate further rate hikes.
Dixon said, “I don’t think this has scared investors away from betting on a weaker yen unless the BOJ takes action at its September meeting and signals a more hawkish stance.”
The pound fell 0.08% to $1.3481. The UK economy grew unexpectedly by 0.3% in June, driven mainly by lower energy prices, the World Cup kickoff, and hot weather.
The Norwegian krone weakened to $9.51. The Norges Bank, as markets expected, left rates unchanged but noted that inflation has started to cool.

Norway’s policy rate is 4.25%, among the highest in the ten advanced economies, and as an oil and gas exporter the country has been supported by the energy sector this year, which has bolstered the krone.

items.title: 挪威央行維持利率4.25%不變 通膨風險與地緣政治仍令政策前景蒙陰
items.title_en: Norway Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% as Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Loom
paras: 挪威央行周四(13日)宣布將基準利率維持在 4.25% 保持不變，此一決定完全符合市場預期，媒體對 16 位分析師進行的調查均準確預測了此結果。
儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息機率降 升值7.8分收32.168元
items.title_en: TWD Rises as Fed Rate Hike Probability Decreases, Closes at 32.168
paras: 隨著外資回補台股，台北匯市受到帶動今(13)日續強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收32.168元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值較昨日擴大至17.22億美元。
新台幣今日以32.22元、升值2.6分開出後，最高來到32.152元，全日高低價差6.8分。
觀察主要亞幣，以新台幣表現較強勁，收升0.24%，美元指數微跌0.02%左右，日元和人民幣小升0.02%上下，星元微貶不到0.05%，泰銖貶約0.1%，韓元則重挫近0.5%。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 7 月 CPI 年增率降至 3.4%、核心 CPI 降至 2.5%，通膨降溫，惟服務價格仍具黏性，加上油價逼近 90 美元，能源通膨風險仍在，預期聯準會短期維持利率不變。
群益投顧也表示，美國7月CPI低於6月的3.5%，核心CPI也從6月的2.6%降至2.5%，皆與市場預期一致，儘管仍明顯高於聯準會設定的2%目標，但與6月數據同樣維持平穩，顯示今年稍早由能源價格推動的通膨正在降溫，市場預期9月聯準會升息機率續降。
paras_en: As foreign capital returns to the Taiwanese stock market, the Taipei foreign exchange market was boosted today, with the New Taiwan dollar (TWD) continuing to rise, closing at 32.168, up 7.8 points, and the trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage Company expanded to $17.22 billion, compared to the previous day.
The TWD opened at 32.22, up 2.6 points, and rose to a high of 32.152 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of 6.8 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the TWD performed relatively strongly, rising 0.24%, while the US dollar index fell slightly by about 0.02%, the Japanese yen and the Chinese yuan rose slightly by around 0.02%, the Singapore dollar fell by less than 0.05%, the Thai baht fell by about 0.1%, and the Korean won plummeted by nearly 0.5%.

According to Cathay Futures research, the US July CPI annual growth rate fell to 3.4%, and the core CPI fell to 2.5%, indicating a decline in inflation, but service prices still have stickiness, and with oil prices approaching $90, energy inflation risks still exist, and it is expected that the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates in the short term.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory also stated that the US July CPI was lower than June's 3.5%, and the core CPI also fell from June's 2.6% to 2.5%, both of which were in line with market expectations, although they were still significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target, but remained stable compared to June's data, indicating that the inflation driven by energy prices earlier this year is easing, and the market expects the probability of a Fed rate hike in September to continue to decline.
